    ∀ (H : Fin d → Type u_2) [(a : Fin d) → Fintype (H a)] (h : (a : Fin d) → ℕ → Ω → H a) (X : Fin d → ℕ → Ω → ℕ)
      (B : Fin d → ℕ → Ω → Prop) (m : Fin d → ℕ) (γ b : ℝ),
      0 ≤ γ →
        1 ≤ b →
          (∀ (a : Fin d), RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.Refining (h a) (m a)) →
            (∀ (a : Fin d) (ω : Ω), RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.UnitIncrements (fun (i : ℕ) => X a i ω) (m a)) →
              (∀ (a : Fin d) (ω : Ω), X a 0 ω = 0) →
                (∀ (a : Fin d), ∀ i ≤ m a, RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.HistoryMeasurable (h a i) (X a i)) →
                  (∀ (a : Fin d), ∀ i ≤ m a, RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.HistoryMeasurable (h a i) (B a i)) →
                    (∀ (a : Fin d),
                        ∀ i < m a,
                          ∀ (v : Ω),
                            B a i v →
                              (0 < RiffleUpperV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => h a i ω = h a i v) →
                                (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect P (fun (ω : Ω) => ↑(X a (m a) ω - X a i ω))
                                    fun (ω : Ω) => h a i ω = h a i v) ≤
                                  γ) →
                      ∀ (C : Ω → Prop),
                        (∀ (ω : Ω), C ω → ∀ (a : Fin d), RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.goodPrefix (B a) (m a) ω) →
                          ∀ (Y : Ω → ℕ),
                            (∀ (ω : Ω), C ω → Y ω ≤ ∑ a : Fin d, X a (m a) ω) →
                              (b ^ d - 1) * γ < 1 →
                                (RiffleUpperV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => if C ω then b ^ Y ω - 1 else 0) ≤
                                  (b ^ d - 1) * γ / (1 - (b ^ d - 1) * γ)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.finiteExplorationTV_of_majorization
type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K) (S1 : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → Prop) (d : ℕ),
  0 < d →
    ∀ (H : Fin d → Type u_1) [(a : Fin d) → Fintype (H a)]
      (h : (a : Fin d) → ℕ → RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → H a)
      (X : Fin d → ℕ → RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → ℕ)
      (B : Fin d → ℕ → RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → Prop) (m : Fin d → ℕ) (γ b : ℝ),
      0 ≤ γ →
        1 ≤ b →
          (∀ (a : Fin d), RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.Refining (h a) (m a)) →
            (∀ (a : Fin d) (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.UnitIncrements (fun (i : ℕ) => X a i ω) (m a)) →
              (∀ (a : Fin d) (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts), X a 0 ω = 0) →
                (∀ (a : Fin d), ∀ i ≤ m a, RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.HistoryMeasurable (h a i) (X a i)) →
                  (∀ (a : Fin d), ∀ i ≤ m a, RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.HistoryMeasurable (h a i) (B a i)) →
                    (∀ (a : Fin d),
                        ∀ i < m a,
                          ∀ (v : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                            B a i v →
                              (0 <
                                  RiffleUpperV2.probability (RiffleUpperV2.independentPairLaw cuts)
                                    fun (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) =>
                                    h a i ω = h a i v) →
                                (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect (RiffleUpperV2.independentPairLaw cuts)
                                    (fun (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) =>
                                      ↑(X a (m a) ω - X a i ω))
                                    fun (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) =>
                                    h a i ω = h a i v) ≤
                                  γ) →
                      (∀ (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                          S1 ω.1 ∧ S1 ω.2 → ∀ (a : Fin d), RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.goodPrefix (B a) (m a) ω) →
                        (∀ (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                            S1 ω.1 ∧ S1 ω.2 →
                              Finset.card (RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω.1 ∩ RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω.2) ≤
                                ∑ a : Fin d, X a (m a) ω) →
                          (∀ (ω ω' : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                              S1 ω →
                                S1 ω' →
                                  RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.overlap (RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω)
                                      (RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω') ≤
                                    b ^ Finset.card (RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω ∩ RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω')) →
                            (b ^ d - 1) * γ < 1 →
                              RiffleUpperV2.tv (RiffleUpperV2.physicalInverseLaw cuts)
                                  (RiffleUpperV2.uniformPermutation N) ≤
                                √((b ^ d - 1) * γ / (1 - (b ^ d - 1) * γ)) / 2 +
                                  RiffleUpperV2.probability (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                    fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) => ¬S1 ω

name: RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.stoppedTail
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] [Fintype H] (P : PMF Ω) (h : ℕ → Ω → H) (X : ℕ → Ω → ℕ)
  (B : ℕ → Ω → Prop) (m : ℕ) (γ : ℝ),
  0 ≤ γ →
    RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.Refining h m →
      (∀ (ω : Ω), RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.UnitIncrements (fun (i : ℕ) => X i ω) m) →
        (∀ i ≤ m, RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.HistoryMeasurable (h i) (B i)) →
          (∀ i < m,
              ∀ (a : Ω),
                B i a →
                  (0 < RiffleUpperV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => h i ω = h i a) →
                    (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect P (fun (ω : Ω) => ↑(X m ω - X i ω)) fun (ω : Ω) => h i ω = h i a) ≤
                      γ) →
            ∀ i ≤ m,
              ∀ (a : Ω),
                (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect P
                    (fun (ω : Ω) =>
                      ↑(RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.stoppedProcess X B m ω -
                          RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.stoppedProcess X B i ω))
                    fun (ω : Ω) => h i ω = h i a) ≤
                  γ

name: RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.unit_choose_step
type:
∀ {X : ℕ → ℕ} {m j : ℕ},
  RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.UnitIncrements X m →
    j < m →
      ∀ (r : ℕ),
        ↑((X m - X j).choose (r + 1)) - ↑((X m - X (j + 1)).choose (r + 1)) =
          ↑(X (j + 1) - X j) * ↑((X m - X (j + 1)).choose r)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.adaptedExcess
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] [Fintype H] (P : PMF Ω) (h : ℕ → Ω → H) (X : ℕ → Ω → ℕ)
  (B : ℕ → Ω → Prop) (m : ℕ) (γ : ℝ),
  0 ≤ γ →
    RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.Refining h m →
      (∀ (ω : Ω), RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.UnitIncrements (fun (i : ℕ) => X i ω) m) →
        (∀ (ω : Ω), X 0 ω = 0) →
          (∀ i ≤ m, RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.HistoryMeasurable (h i) (X i)) →
            (∀ i ≤ m, RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.HistoryMeasurable (h i) (B i)) →
              (∀ i < m,
                  ∀ (a : Ω),
                    B i a →
                      (0 < RiffleUpperV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => h i ω = h i a) →
                        (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect P (fun (ω : Ω) => ↑(X m ω - X i ω)) fun (ω : Ω) =>
                            h i ω = h i a) ≤
                          γ) →
                ∀ (C : Ω → Prop),
                  (∀ (ω : Ω), C ω → RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.goodPrefix B m ω) →
                    ∀ (t : ℝ),
                      0 ≤ t →
                        (Real.exp t - 1) * γ < 1 →
                          (RiffleUpperV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => if C ω then Real.exp (t * ↑(X m ω)) - 1 else 0) ≤
                            (Real.exp t - 1) * γ / (1 - (Real.exp t - 1) * γ)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.convexExcess
type:
∀ {d : ℕ},
  0 < d →
    ∀ {b : ℝ},
      0 < b →
        ∀ (x : Fin d → ℕ), b ^ ∑ a : Fin d, x a - 1 ≤ (∑ a : Fin d, (Real.exp (↑d * Real.log b * ↑(x a)) - 1)) / ↑d

type:

name: RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.stoppedProcess_tail_le
type:

  (∀ (ω : Ω), RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.UnitIncrements (fun (j : ℕ) => X j ω) m) →

        RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.stoppedProcess X B m ω - RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.stoppedProcess X B i ω ≤

name: RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.finiteExplorationTV
type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K) (S1 : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → Prop) (bound : ℕ),
  2 ≤ bound →
    (∀ (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
        S1 ω → RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.BoundedComponents (RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω) bound) →
      ∀ (d : ℕ),
        0 < d →
          ∀ (H : Fin d → Type u_1) [(a : Fin d) → Fintype (H a)]
            (h : (a : Fin d) → ℕ → RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → H a)
            (X : Fin d → ℕ → RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → ℕ)
            (B : Fin d → ℕ → RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → Prop) (m : Fin d → ℕ) (γ : ℝ),
            0 ≤ γ →
              (∀ (a : Fin d), RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.Refining (h a) (m a)) →
                (∀ (a : Fin d) (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                    RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.UnitIncrements (fun (i : ℕ) => X a i ω) (m a)) →
                  (∀ (a : Fin d) (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts), X a 0 ω = 0) →
                    (∀ (a : Fin d), ∀ i ≤ m a, RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.HistoryMeasurable (h a i) (X a i)) →
                      (∀ (a : Fin d), ∀ i ≤ m a, RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.HistoryMeasurable (h a i) (B a i)) →
                        (∀ (a : Fin d),
                            ∀ i < m a,
                              ∀ (v : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                                B a i v →
                                  (0 <
                                      RiffleUpperV2.probability (RiffleUpperV2.independentPairLaw cuts)
                                        fun (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) =>
                                        h a i ω = h a i v) →
                                    (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect (RiffleUpperV2.independentPairLaw cuts)
                                        (fun (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) =>
                                          ↑(X a (m a) ω - X a i ω))
                                        fun (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) =>
                                        h a i ω = h a i v) ≤
                                      γ) →
                          (∀ (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                              S1 ω.1 ∧ S1 ω.2 → ∀ (a : Fin d), RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.goodPrefix (B a) (m a) ω) →
                            (∀ (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                                S1 ω.1 ∧ S1 ω.2 →
                                  Finset.card (RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω.1 ∩ RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω.2) ≤
                                    ∑ a : Fin d, X a (m a) ω) →
                              (RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.componentConstant bound ^ d - 1) * γ < 1 →
                                RiffleUpperV2.tv (RiffleUpperV2.physicalInverseLaw cuts)
                                    (RiffleUpperV2.uniformPermutation N) ≤
                                  √((RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.componentConstant bound ^ d - 1) * γ /
                                          (1 - (RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.componentConstant bound ^ d - 1) * γ)) /
                                      2 +
                                    RiffleUpperV2.probability (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                      fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) => ¬S1 ω

name: RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.goodPrefix_mono
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {B : ℕ → Ω → Prop} {i j : ℕ} {ω : Ω},
  i ≤ j → RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.goodPrefix B j ω → RiffleUpperV2.Exponential.goodPrefix B i ω
